claim: A captured phone-QA candidate can be explicitly routed to the existing Review Inbox while the UI keeps proof and warning authority false.

action.fixture: All six physical-behavior declarations remained false; only voluntary candidate capture was checked.

observedSequence: The incomplete candidate produced a visible retry-or-stop notice and one local device receipt.
The review control became enabled after persistence.
Opening review produced a visible no-warning-cleared notice and an Open Review Inbox link.
The inbox showed one pending Phone QA candidate bound to the same exact digest.
Inspect exact digest showed candidateComplete false, physicalHardwareProven false, warningClosureAuthorized false, and manifestMutationAuthorized false.
nextCheapestTest: An actual person may voluntarily review a real physical-phone candidate later; that remains NOT_RUN and is not required for adapter correctness.
